articles.title: Sensex surges 905 points, Nifty closes 1.05% higher as Fed rate pause boosts market sentiment
articles.description: Indian stock markets rallied on Thursday, with the Sensex surging over 905 points and the Nifty gaining 1.05 per cent, as the US Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates unchanged, a marginal easing in crude oil prices, and renewed institutional buying improved investor sentiment.

articles.title: India's 100% ethanol-run vehicle push faces Supreme Court question to govt over fuel supply
articles.description: The Supreme Court questioned the Centre over ethanol supply for 100% ethanol-run vehicles after India amended motor vehicle rules to permit E100 flex-fuel vehicles. The government acknowledged that large-scale manufacturing changes would be necessary. The court also highlighted farmers' interests while examining ethanol allocation disputes, as the Centre ruled out increasing petrol ethanol blending beyond the current 20% level.

articles.title: India’s growth outlook for FY27 remains resilient amid inflation risks
articles.description: India may sustain growth in FY27, but crude oil prices, food inflation and El Niño pose risks. Forex reserves provide 10.3 months of import cover.
